story.value: The name comes from the Arabic word zargun, which means gold-like.
German chemist Martin Heinrich Klaproth discovered zirconium in 1789 while analyzing a mineral called jargon.
Swedish chemist Jöns Jacob Berzelius first isolated zirconium in 1824, but it was not pure.

uses.value: Zirconium is used to make some types of surgical equipment.
Zirconium oxide, also called zircon, is used as a gem material.
Zirconium dioxide can withstand very high temperatures and is used to line the walls of high temperature furnaces.
Zirconium is widely used in nuclear reactors.
